on 16 March, 2023
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Mummineni Sudheer Kumar
 Writ Petition No.6789 of 2023
Order:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land
Acquisition representing learned Additional Advocate General appearing for the respondents.
2. It is the case

of the petitioner that the properties belonging to the members of the petitioner - association were acquired by passing an award bearing No.25/2011-12, dated 26.12.2011, in File No.B/1958/09, acquiring the land to an extent of 64993.635 sq. meters and 704 houses/structures of Elgandal Village, Kothapalli Mandal, Karimnagar District, and the members of the petitioner - association also made a request under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short, 'the Act, 1894') and also submitted various representations.

In spite of the same, the award is not referred by the respondents under Section 18 of the Act, 1894 to the competent civil Court and hence the petitioner - association approached this Court by filing the present writ petition.

3. It is contended by Sri Ponnam Ashok Goud, learned counsel for the petitioner, that in similar circumstances, this Court allowed W.P.No.23033 of 2020, by an order dated 30.01.2022, and pursuant thereto, the respondents have referred the cases therein under Section 18 of the Act, 1894.
But, in the present case, the cases of the members of the petitioner - association are not referred and the representation submitted by the petitioner - association is still pending.

4. Sri L. Ram Das, learned Assistant Government Pleader representing learned Additional Advocate General has placed before this Court the instructions received from the respondents and the relevant portion from the said written instructions as under:
"...4. After completion of required process under LA Act, 1894 the then LAO and SDC has passed the award U/sec. 11(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 vide award No.
25/2011-12, Dt. 26.12.2011 in file No. B/1958/09 for an extent of 64993.635 Sq. Mtrs.
covering with 704 houses/structures stated to have the members of Welfare Committee of Displaced House Owners of Elgandal (V) situated at Elgandal (V)
Kothapalli (M), Karimnagar District for an amount of Rs. 47, 12,20,584.00 (Rs. Forty seven crores twelve lakhs twenty thousand five hundred and eighty four) only and paid compensation- 5.

Aggrieved with the compensation paid by the LAO & SDC, the awardees have filed protest petitions U/sec. 18 of the LA Act 1894 through their counsel with request to refer the matter to Civil Court for re-determination of the compensation.

sentences.text: Displaced House Owners of Elgandal (v) and other petitioners covered in the same award have filed petitions in different dates.
On verification of connected records, the petitions filed by the petitioners U/sec. 18 of the LA Act are within limitation.

It is submitted that due to ongoing land acquisition work, merging of other LA Units in this Unit, formation of New Districts, transfer of LA files as per jurisdictions, the petitions filed by the petitioners U/sec. 18 of the LA Act in respect of their structures/houses pertaining to Welfare Committee of Displaced House Owners of Elgandal and others could not be disposed off in time.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
6. Aggrieved with the In action of the LAO & SDC, the awardees of House bearing Nos. 5-31/3,
9/-91, 11-42, 1- 23, 4-75, 9-25, 9-5, 2-46, 9-11/1, 2-46/1, 2-39 and 2-31 situated at Elgandal (V) of Kothapalli Mandal have approached the Hon'ble High Court of the State of Telangana at Hyderabad and fled W.P.NO.23033 of 2020 and the same was allowed by the Hon'ble Court on 31.1.2022 and directed the Respondent Officer i.e., LAO & SDC to refer the matter to Civil Court.
7. Accordingly the Houses/structures covered in W.P. 23033/2020 along with other structures total (1191) structures reference have been made to the Hon'ble Principal Junior Civil Judge at Karimnagar for re-determination of the compensation.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
But the said reference was returned on 2.2.2023 with an objection that the reference may be made in respect of the (10) claimants only instead of 1191.
8.
In compliance of the Hon'ble Court orders separate action is being taken.
In the mean time the Welfare Committee of Displaced House Owners of Elgandal (v) of Kothapalli Mandal approached the Hon'ble High Court and filed this writ petition.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Further action in the matter will be initiated subject to outcome of Hon'ble High Court orders."
5.

In the light of the said written instructions, as extracted hereinabove, it is clear that the request made by the members of the petitioner - association is well within the time and the respondents would refer the matter under section 18 of the Act, 1894.
However, the only reason given by the respondents for the delay in referring the cases is that they are busy in other acquisition proceedings.
Be that as it may, the entitlement of the members of the petitioner - association to seek reference under Section 18 of the Act, 1894 is not disputed.

6. In the circumstances, the writ petition is disposed of directing respondent Nos.2 and 3 to take immediate steps for referring the cases of the members of the petitioner - association under Section 18 of the Act, 1894 and complete the said process within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any, pending in this writ petition shall stand closed.
MUMMINENI SUDHEER KUMAR, J Date:16.03.2023 Note:- Issue C.C. by 20.03.2023.
(B/o) KH THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE MUMMINENI SUDHEER KUMAR Date:16.03.2023
